summaryForNext: 2 changes created on the openspec backend; zeespec gate n/a (no .zeespec/, opt-in). Both validate: node scripts/spec-validate.mjs -> 9 passed, 0 failed. CHANGE 1 hook-entry-node-only: new capability hooks/dispatch (6 requirements, 14 scenarios) + a MODIFIED continuous-integration delta. Scope is the 6 ported hook ids from analyze. Task 0.1 is BLOCKING (the goal-1 re-review of 4 unreviewed lib/platform fixes); task 1.1 is the exec-form probe with an explicit stop condition - if it fails, the change is re-planned, not patched. CHANGE 2 artifact-refiner-node: new capability refiner/qa-gate (7 requirements, 26 scenarios). Ports the 661-line core loop to lib/refiner/, carries 19 .mjs + 20 sub-skills + 5 agents + 11 schemas, fixes the one Windows hazard (model-routing.mjs:36 execSync of a .sh -> Node fetch), and wires /refine-validate into the gate, closing reflection Delta 2. Sequenced AFTER change 1 per operator choice. MODIFIED DELTA VERIFIED in both rounds: the continuous-integration delta repeats all 4 current scenarios and adds 2. This is the defect CI caught last phase, so it was checked programmatically after every edit. OPERATOR DECISIONS: artifact-refiner is IN the QA contract (closes corrective action 3). Scope confirmed as the measured core, NOT the 7 scaffolders (2,879 lines) or 17 installers (1,540 lines), which are a follow-up change. REVIEW: round 1 BLOCK (2 CRITICAL, 3 WARNING, 2 SUGGESTION) -> round 2 BLOCK (2 CRITICAL, 1 WARNING, 1 SUGGESTION, all NEW). All accepted and fixed. Cap is 2 rounds; per corrective action 1 a change reaching round 3 STOPS, so no third round ran. The round-2 fixes are UNREVIEWED and self-reviewed only. ROOT CAUSE of both round-2 CRITICALs, fixed at source: I called 19 .mjs 'existing' and specced a review of them - they exist upstream, this project has two, and nothing carried them, so tasks edited absent files and a .sh-only scan let six .mjs-only skills through. Recorded in .prometheus/gotchas.md. WARNING carried: every line count was inflated one per file by split('\n').length. Re-derived with wc -l (core 661 not 671, scaffolders 2,879, installers 1,540, .mjs 4,501). Conclusions unaffected, but the phase goal requires every count to cite its command. JUDGE CAVEAT: the liter-llm gateway answered /health 200 but rejected /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions with 'Missing or invalid Authorization header', and no credential exists in the environment or any config path the bridge reads. Both rounds used a fresh-context subagent from the producer's own model family: cross_model_check is NOT verified-distinct, a weaker check than cross-model. STILL OPEN for plan/execute: the exec-form probe (blocking, task 1.1), the goal-1 re-review (blocking, task 0.1), and the fact that change 2's gate does not retroactively cover change 1.
